panel_domain_filter: Only rows whose domain matches the score domain are used to construct each country series.
sample_definition: Frozen common three-domain country set in each historical fold.
sampling_assumption: Within each draw, each country/domain/cycle score is sampled once from N(published mean, published marginal SE^2). That value is shared when it serves as a historical context input or training label. Cross-country and cross-cycle sampling/link covariance are not modeled.
refit_scope: Ridge, Random Forest, and XGBoost are refitted on each draw's perturbed historical features and training labels for every domain and target cycle. Held-out target means remain fixed for scoring. Persistence and linear trend are recomputed from the perturbed context.
fit_parallelism: Single-threaded. Compared with n_jobs=-1 on the same seeded draw; maximum fold/model MAE difference was 3.2e-14.
note_timesfm_excluded: TimesFM model-input uncertainty excluded: refitting TimesFM per draw requires GPU and is infeasible in this analysis. TimesFM point predictions from pisa_all_models_quadratic_trend_v1 are not perturbed here.
note_target_held_fixed: Target scores (true_score) are always the published OECD means. Only context input scores are perturbed. This is orthogonal to the target-score SE analysis in pisa_target_sampling_uncertainty_v3.
note_retrospective: PISA 2025 is excluded. All folds are historical temporal validation. Results do not constitute prospective or blind evaluation.
